name: vestry
title: Vestry
description: A parish-church theme on limewash white: the regular week hangs as an oak hymn board, each service time a white slide-in card of heavy black figures on a grooved rail, with the day in rubric red and the rest set quietly in an old-style serif.

tokens.--font-text: the old-style serif for everything except the cards: headings, text, the menu and every small capital
tokens.--font-card: the heavy grotesque of the figures on the hymn-board cards
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small capitals: menu, days, places, dates, statuses, roles
tokens.--card-size: size of the figures on a hymn-board card, from phone to wide screen
tokens.--color-bg: the limewash ground of every page
tokens.--color-text: prayer-book ink: headings, text, the name, the menu, the heavy rule under a block heading and the focus outline
tokens.--color-muted: quieter ink: the intro, places, times in the lists, roles, descriptions, the founded line, the address, past dates
tokens.--color-accent: waxed oak for links, the current menu entry and its underline, the all-welcome status and the quotation bar
tokens.--color-rubric: rubric red, used only for the day names beside the hymn-board cards
tokens.--color-rule: thin rules between events, news, people and table rows, under the masthead and above the footer
tokens.--color-wash: the faint panel behind code and the members-only status
tokens.--color-oak: the hymn-board frame: crest, stiles, rails and sill, and the ground of selected text
tokens.--color-oak-deep: the dark recessed panel of the board behind the cards
tokens.--color-oak-edge: the grain of the panel, the grooves beside the stiles and under each rail, and the shadow under the sill
tokens.--color-oak-light: the waxed highlight along the top of each rail and the sill
tokens.--color-gilt: the gilt lettering of the heading on the board's crest, and selected text
tokens.--color-card-ink: the heavy black figures on the cards
tokens.--shadow-card: the edge and drop shadow that stand a card off the board (a faint lamplight glow by night)
tokens.--measure-text: maximum width of a line of running text
tokens.--board: width of the hymn board, frame included
tokens.--pitch: height of one rail of the hymn board: every card slot is this tall unless its own card wraps
tokens.--stile: thickness of the board's side stiles
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of statuses, the sill, code and images
tokens.--space-1: hairline gaps: inside menu links, between a title and the lines under it
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under the masthead, inside lists and headings
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens and padding of a ruled row
tokens.--space-4: gap between columns, under the page heading and above prose headings
tokens.--space-5: large gap between blocks and at the foot of the page
